title: OutpostRun
description: An offer of the outposts' door's runs lane as a personal outpost sees it once it has opened the envelope with its sealing key (door protocol 2, ADR 0226 §4, ADR 0227 §1): what it runs, where the run's API is, and the run token minted when the instance claimed the offer. It is sealed to that instance only, under the offer's id (`outpost-door.yaml`, `x-sealing`, `run`), and the row the door keeps never holds the token. It carries no gateway key and no subscription's credential: a subscription stays on its owner's runner (ADR 0227 §4). A daemon ignores a field it does not know.

id.description: The offer's id: the envelope's too, and the associated data it was sealed under. The run's id for a stage's run (`run_id`), the turn's id for a conversation turn (`turn_id`). A daemon starts nothing whose id is not its envelope's.

kind.description: `stage_run`: a stage's run, which the runner runs as an executor would. `conversation_turn`: one turn of a conversation placed on its owner's runner (ADR 0226 §11). The same kind as the offer carries in clear, or the daemon starts nothing.

run_id.description: `stage_run`: the run's id, which the runner reports under. Null for a turn.

conversation_id.description: `conversation_turn`: the conversation the turn belongs to.

turn_id.description: `conversation_turn`: the turn the offer runs, one offer per turn.

api_url.description: Where the runner calls the run's API: a run door (ADR 0144, ADR 0226 §12), in a personal installation its loopback and its `runs` network. Never the outposts' door, which carries assignments and no run API, and never the relay.

run_token.description: The run token, minted when the instance claimed the offer and never before (ADR 0226 §4): it speaks for this run, or for this turn on the internal session routes only, and lapses with it, the run's maximum minutes plus 15, a turn's plus 5 (ADR 0226 §11). A daemon hands it to the runner and reads nothing in it.

env.description: The runner's environment beyond its id, address and token, by name: what the deployment passes every run (its `TRANIBOR_ENV`, its egress proxy). Never a secret of the platform (an offer carries no gateway key in phase A, ADR 0226 §9) and never a subscription's credential.

credential.description: Where the run's model credential comes from (ADR 0227 §1), as placement chose it: `subscription`, the sign-in on this runner of the provider below; `gateway`, the platform's, which no offer carries in phase A (ADR 0226 §9).

provider.description: `subscription`: the vendor whose sign-in on this runner the run uses, one the instance announced (`runner.subscriptions`). Null for a gateway run.

isolation.description: Where the agent runs, as placement chose it for a mode the instance announced (ADR 0226 §10): `container`, the docker mode's container of its own; `process`, the native mode's child process, placed only under the organisation's `native: accepted`.

lease_s.description: The lease the claiming instance's polls renew by listing the run in `runs_running` (`x-run-lease`): longer than a poll's longest wait, and never past the claim plus `max_minutes`.

max_minutes.description: The run's maximum minutes, or the turn's: what bounds it with its turns and its tool calls, since a subscription run is under no USD budget (ADR 0227 §7).
